R665.note: jwt.verify with explicit algorithms and fail-secure on missing secret; HS256/env-secret assumptions are stated openly.

R666.note: Identity allowlist matches exactly the renderer's real public methods; unknown macros now no-op instead of a fatal error, and that behavior change is stated in the explanation.

R672.note: AES/GCM/NoPadding with fresh random IV prepended to the ciphertext; standard authenticated-encryption fix, format change is disclosed.

R674.note: Allowlist of report names closes the vector; the added System.setProperty("jdk.lang.Process.allowAmbiguousCommands",...) call is actually a no-op at runtime per Oracle's docs (must be set via -D at JVM launch, not System.setProperty), but this is harmless since the allowlist alone already blocks any dangerous reportName.

R675.note: Uses the real 4-arg DirContext.search(name, filter, filterArgs, cons) overload; JNDI escapes filterArgs per RFC 4515.

R676.note: SqlCommand with bound @Region parameter feeding SqlDataAdapter(cmd); correct parameterization, connection properly disposed.

R677.note: Adds caller.Role != "admin" check using the existing Role field, placed before the sink; correct and minimal.

R680.note: Argument-array + shell=False closes shell-metacharacter injection, but the filename regex still allows a leading '-', so a crafted filename can still be read as a libreoffice command-line flag (option injection) since no '--' end-of-options marker is added.

R681.note: Minimal positional-arg fix setting secure=true; correct.

R682.note: HttpUtility.HtmlEncode() at the output sink; standard, correct XSS fix.

R691.note: Replaces the string-eval setTimeout with a closure callback; removes code generation entirely, correct.

R696.note: toRealPath() plus Path.startsWith containment check, preserving the original exists-then-404 ordering; thorough and correct.

R697.note: Correct 4-arg parameterized search() overload reusing the existing SUBTREE_SCOPE SearchControls.
